title: Scammers Pose as NYPD Officers in “Well-Done” Video-Call Impersonation Scam
content_md: The phone rang, and when “Eddie” (not his real name) picked up, the caller identified herself as being from American Express. Even though Eddie didn’t have any American Express account, he wasn’t initially suspicious. According to the caller, Eddie’s name had shown up in an attempt to purchase a firearm, and AmEx suspected identity theft… Source Article Link: https://databreaches.net/2026/08/21/scammers-pose-as-nypd-officers-in-well-done-video-call-impersonation-scam/
